en.eh.story.instruction: What happened first? Put the story in order.
en.eh.story.correct: Yes. Here is the whole story.
en.eh.story.incorrect: Not quite. Which one comes first?
en.eh.story.hint.model: Look for how it starts. Then look for how it ends.
en.eh.ending.correct: Yes. That is how it ends.
en.eh.ending.incorrect: That is from a different story. Look again.
en.eh.ending.hint.model: Look at the story so far. What is it about?
en.eh.why.incorrect: That did not do it. Think again.
en.eh.why.hint.model: Look at how it was, and how it is now.
en.eh.next.incorrect: That is not what happens. Think again.
en.eh.why.snow: The snowman melted. What made it melt?
en.eh.next.snow: The sun shines on the snowman. What happens next?
en.eh.why.balloon: The balloon burst. What made it burst?
en.eh.why.balloon.correct: Yes. The pin burst the balloon.
en.eh.next.balloon: A pin touches the balloon. What happens next?
en.eh.why.tower: The tower fell down. What knocked it down?
en.eh.why.tower.correct: Yes. The ball knocked the tower down.
en.eh.next.tower: A ball rolls into the tower. What happens next?
en.eh.why.seed: The seed began to grow. What helped it grow?
en.eh.why.seed.correct: Yes. Water helped the seed to grow.
en.eh.next.seed: Water falls on the seed. What happens next?
en.eh.next.seed.correct: Yes. The seed begins to grow.
en.eh.why.castle: The sandcastle is gone. What washed it away?
en.eh.why.castle.correct: Yes. A wave washed it away.
en.eh.next.castle: A wave rolls over the sandcastle. What happens next?
en.eh.next.castle.correct: Yes. The sandcastle is washed flat.
en.eh.why.rain: There is a puddle on the path. What made the puddle?
en.eh.why.rain.correct: Yes. The rain made the puddle.
en.eh.next.rain: Rain falls on the path. What happens next?
en.eh.next.rain.correct: Yes. The rain leaves a puddle.
en.eh.why.cheese: Someone has nibbled the cheese. Who was it?
en.eh.why.cheese.correct: Yes. The mouse nibbled the cheese.
en.eh.next.cheese: A mouse finds the cheese. What happens next?
en.eh.next.cheese.correct: Yes. The mouse nibbles the cheese.
en.eh.why.kite: The kite is up in the sky. What lifted it?
en.eh.why.kite.correct: Yes. The wind lifted the kite.
en.eh.next.kite: The wind blows on the kite. What happens next?
en.eh.next.kite.correct: Yes. The kite flies up high.
en.eh.water.demo: This is a map. Green is land. Blue is water. Which flag is on the water?
en.eh.water.instruction: Which flag is on the water?
en.eh.water.correct: Yes. That flag is on the water.
en.eh.water.incorrect: That flag is on the land. Look for the blue water.
en.eh.water.hint.model: The water is the blue part.
en.eh.land.demo: This is a map. Blue is water. Green is land. Which flag is on the land?
en.eh.land.instruction: Which flag is on the land?
en.eh.land.correct: Yes. That flag is on the land.
en.eh.land.incorrect: That flag is on the water. Look for the green land.
en.eh.land.hint.model: The land is the green part.
en.eh.near.demo: Here is a boat. Which island is nearest? Nearest means the shortest way to go.
en.eh.near.instruction: Which island is nearest to the boat?
en.eh.near.correct: Yes. That one is nearest. It is a short way to go.
en.eh.near.incorrect: Another one is nearer. Look again.
en.eh.near.hint.model: Look at the lines. The shortest line goes to the nearest.
en.eh.far.demo: Here is a boat. Which island is farthest away? Farthest means the longest way to go.
en.eh.far.instruction: Which island is farthest from the boat?
en.eh.far.correct: Yes. That one is farthest. It is a long way to go.
en.eh.far.incorrect: Another one is farther away. Look again.
en.eh.far.hint.model: Look at the lines. The longest line goes to the farthest.

skills.title: Put a story in order
skills.objective: Puts three pictures of something that happens into the order it happens in: beginning, middle and end.

skills.title: Say how a story ends
skills.objective: Shown the beginning and the middle of a short story, picks the picture it ends with from among the endings of other stories.

skills.title: Say what made it happen
skills.objective: Shown a thing before and after something happened to it, picks what did it from three things, two of which could not have.

skills.title: Say what happens next
skills.objective: Shown a thing and what is about to happen to it, picks how it will turn out from three pictures.

skills.title: Find water on a map
skills.objective: On a simple map of sea and islands, picks the one flag of two or three that stands on water.

skills.title: Find land on a map
skills.objective: On a simple map of sea and islands, picks the one flag of two or three that stands on land.

skills.title: Find the nearest place
skills.objective: On a map with a boat and three islands, picks the island nearest to the boat.

skills.title: Find the farthest place
skills.objective: On a map with a boat and three islands, picks the island farthest from the boat.

lessons.title: Put the story in order
lessons.summary: Three pictures show something happening: a seed that grows, a snowman that melts. They are out of order. Your child puts them first, next and last, and then the story is told back, picture by picture.

lessons.title: Which flag is on the water?
lessons.summary: A map shows blue sea and green islands, with two or three flags. Your child taps the flag that stands on the water. Every flag is well clear of a shore, so there is never a doubt about which it is.

lessons.title: Which flag is on the land?
lessons.summary: The same kind of map, asked the other way about: your child taps the flag that stands on land.

lessons.title: Which island is nearest?
lessons.summary: A boat is on the sea with three small islands round it. Your child taps the island that is nearest to the boat, and the boat sails there. One island is always nearer by a good deal.
